interpretations.exact_text: A young man is seated under a tree and contemplates three cups set on the grass before him; an arm issuing from a cloud offers him another cup. His expression notwithstanding is one of discontent with his environment.
interpretations.locator: Part III, §2, The Lesser Arcana, Suit of Cups, Four

interpretations.exact_text: Weariness, disgust, aversion, imaginary vexations, as if the wine of this world had caused satiety only; another wine, as if a fairy gift, is now offered the wastrel, but he sees no consolation therein. This is also a card of blended pleasure.
interpretations.locator: Part III, §2, The Lesser Arcana, Suit of Cups, Four
